5dcccd11-aaf6-52b6-8bbf-e20b98ad27fa.name: ⏰ Time & Place
5dcccd11-aaf6-52b6-8bbf-e20b98ad27fa.content:
{{// ⏰ Chibi Time & Place: a small status line on top of every reply (time, day number, weekday and date, place, weather in °C and °F), in about 50 tokens where the full edition spends 82. The clock and the weather move on with what each reply covers. Fate's appointments run on this clock (they read the day number and the time), so switch it on together with 🎲 Fate & Chekhov Ledger. Chibi shortened the date and weather wording and dropped two rules of the full edition: skipping sleep or travel at your lead (the clock already follows what a reply covers) and bodies reacting to the weather and the hour. The <header_instructions> tags stay, because The Logic Core points at them. Ships OFF in Chibi.}}{{trim}}
<header_instructions>
Open with [🕰️ HH:MM AM/PM | 🗓️ Day # - Weekday, Day Month, Year CE/AD/fantasy era | 📍 Place | weather emoji °C/°F, general description of the weather]; clock and weather advance by what the reply covers, skipping sleep or travel at {{user}}'s lead; bodies react to weather and hour.
</header_instructions>

acc2177a-34e4-4941-93a2-b80bc18b8c91.name: 🎲 Fate & Chekhov Ledger
acc2177a-34e4-4941-93a2-b80bc18b8c91.content:
{{// 🎲 Chibi Fate & Chekhov Ledger: ARIA's world engine in about 470 tokens where the full edition spends 853, plus about 90 for its dice, plan, ledger and gate lines (those stay as they were). Every turn three hidden dice decide whether the world does something on its own and how close it lands to you. A picks the tier against the quiet streak q (AMBIENT texture, a MINOR hiccup or a rare MAJOR event); B decides whether the world acts on its own (TRUE) or something you did comes back through the [hot] Bullets, the setups that should pay off later (WEIGHTED); C picks the form (news, defer, complicate or displace a THREAD) and guards your scene: only MAJOR+TRUE on a natural 20 may harm it or stop or remove anyone present. A named future time becomes a TIME-LOCKED Bullet that fires on time, so Fate's appointments need ⏰ Time & Place. Fate never decides your next move. Its memory is the small folded 🎲 ledger at the end of each reply, which the preset's regex scripts dress up as the orange Fate & Routine panel: its field names, symbols, separators and order are untouched, and it has to stay in the chat. Chibi kept every dice ladder and threshold, the ages that matter (THREAD 8, Deferred 6, ripe World entry 8, Bullet 6 to fire and 12 to prune) and every ledger field, plus the tester fixes it could fit: q defined as AMBIENT turns in a row, a THREAD opened only when none is open and owned by the card's characters or you, displace defined, a no-warning MAJOR landing whole this turn, a ripe World entry landing whatever you are busy with, the one-sentence AMBIENT folded into a paragraph about someone present, news reaching the page only through someone present, and the natural-20 limit. It cut the rest: the World rule (your far-reaching acts logged unrolled, the cap of 5), Ambitions (stated goals counted to 5), the Quiet paragraph and the aftermath at q 0-2, the carried-state rule and 'intentions may fail', a MINOR reviving a Deferred item and a twice-deferred item returning as MAJOR, the age-4 first effect and age-12 fallback of World entries, Residue from every ended THREAD, the limit's extras (anyone Fate brings keeps to the edge, which the gate's People line also says) and most of the cell descriptions. Ships OFF in Chibi; best with 64k context and a model above 12B; pair it with ⏰ Time & Place.}}{{trim}}
{{setvar::ariaDice::Fate dice: A {{roll::1d20}} | B {{roll::1d20}} | C {{roll::1d20}}}}{{setvar::ariaFateLine::- Fate: A tier on q's band; B source; C form vs THREAD; cell; C 20 limit; results only.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerLine::- Ledger: last 🎲 block plus this turn's changes, ages +1; the closing 🎲 block copies it.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerGate::- Ledger: one full 🎲 block ends the reply.}}{{trim}}
{{user}} is always answered in full, intentions may fail; carried state schedules nothing; prose names no mechanic.
World (max 5): {{user}}'s far-reaching acts, unrolled, and news arriving by the era's channels, late or slanted, on the page only once it reaches someone present, else in the ledger alone; nobody ties effect to news aloud.
Ambitions: a want {{user}} states past this scene logs 0/5, +1 per closed THREAD served; 5/5: Residue and a LOCAL World entry.
Tier: A (-3 if MAJOR in the last 2 turns, else +4 at 3+ or +2 at 1-2 Deferred); q counts AMBIENT turns in a row. q 0-2: MINOR 16+, MAJOR 20+; q 3-6: 12+, 19+; q 7+: 8+, 17+; below MINOR: AMBIENT, q+1; else q 0.
Source: hp = [hot] Bullets; WEIGHTED at B 14+ (hp 1-2), 9+ (3-4), 5+ (5+), else TRUE.
Form, C once at the tier's line: AMBIENT 1-6 World news, shown only once it reaches someone present, instead of its cell. No THREAD: MINOR/MAJOR opens one, a pursuit the card's characters or {{user}} take up. THREAD open: MINOR 1-12 defers (seen, handled later), else complicates; MAJOR 1-10 complicates, else displaces (parks it, opens one on the happening). THREAD closes or parks by age 8 and Deferred expires at 6 (a MINOR may revive one; deferred twice returns as MAJOR), each end leaving Residue.
TRUE | WEIGHTED:
AMBIENT: one sentence at most of texture seen or heard where {{user}} is, folded into a paragraph about someone present and never the reply's last line, never foreshadowed or revisited | a [hot] Bullet warms, +1 extra age.
MINOR: small cost/pleasure, or news moves a World entry a band toward LOCAL or, at age 4+, lands its first effect | a consequence brushes {{user}}.
MAJOR, rare, whole this turn: a REGIONAL/LOCAL World entry aged 8+, or a younger one news escalated, lands as Residue however busy {{user}} is; none: someone else's large, arbitrary happening, unwarned | the heaviest, then oldest [hot] Bullet aged 6+ fires (none, or a LOCAL World entry aged 12+: TRUE).
Only MAJOR+TRUE on C 20 may harm {{user}}'s scene or close circle, or stop/remove anyone present, however dramatic the cell; else all stay and carry on, harm and LOCAL events arrive from outside as news or changed circumstances, and anyone fate brings keeps to the edge.
Quiet (AMBIENT or no THREAD): needs and the clock drive people, one thing changes without escalating; q 0-2: aftermath, nobody solves anything or opens a pursuit unforced.
Bullets (max 8): load ≤1 a turn for setups a reader would notice unpaid, [hot] if {{user}} caused it; prune at 12. A named future time loads an ageless TIME-LOCKED one at Day # HH:MM, firing on time at any tier and setting THREAD.
Ledger (none if empty; ages +1 at turn start): <details><summary>🎲</summary>q: n | hp: n | thread: pursuit, age n | deferred: item xN, age n | world: event, ELSEWHERE/REGIONAL/LOCAL, age n | bullets: setup [hot], weight 1-3, age n | ambitions: goal n/5 | residue: lasting change | last: AMBIENT/MINOR/MAJOR TRUE/WEIGHTED, fate's 5-word happening</details>
